name: hackathon-ciudades-creativas
description: Monorepo desacoplado para Ciudades Creativas (Frontend Next.js + Backend Express API)

scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
